title: On the Linear Convergence of SISTA for Entropic Martingale Optimal Transport
summary: We prove a linear convergence rate of a Sinkhorn-type algorithm for entropic martingale optimal transport in arbitrary dimension. The algorithm follows a block-coordinate ascent scheme, alternating exact Sinkhorn updates for the marginal potentials with an explicit gradient step for the potential associated with the martingale constraint. Under irreducibility and non-degeneracy assumptions on the compactly supported marginals, we establish linear convergence of the dual objective values and iterates.
